items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Do you think Henson is the first puppeteer? No, there was some other guy whose name I forgot...Paris, his name was Paris.

ctx.x: Four pianos. And puppets. Do you think Henson is the first puppeteer? No, there was some other guy whose name I forgot...Paris, his name was Paris. He was a puppeteer, Frank Paris. And he had this puppets with the piano. Then we had a third or fourth show.
Well, what did you do with these four pianos?
